notes.title: Rainbows, toilets & unicorns OST!
notes.content:
Relive the extraordinary atmosphere of the fast-paced action of Rainbows, toilets & unicorns with the amazing and original Japanese-style soundtrack by Hanzo ! 


https://static.wixstatic.com/media/48ef42_260f7dcb387541ab885c51ca175a1596~mv2.gif




You can get it  here! 




#FantasticoChallenge

We are very excited for the release of the OST that we want to run a #FantasticoChallenge!

Joining the #FantasticoChallenge is very easy:
[olist] 
 Get the Rainbows, Toilets & Unicorns OST  
 Create any kind of content with the music from the OST in the background. They can be videos, graphic animations, lyrics or even dances!
 Post them here in our game community
[/olist]  

Best ones will be shared on Fantastico Studio's social channels. 

Are you ready to accept this challenge?
